hero_sub: Heat and Dust Punish Loose Tolerances
hero: Tuk-tuk engines in Egypt idle in traffic, pull heavy loads and breathe dusty air for most of the day. Parts that are made carelessly wear unevenly in those conditions and fail early. Our three wheeler engine parts for Egypt are produced to accurate tolerances so engines keep performing between services.
We cast and CNC machine the parts at our IATF 16949 certified plant in India, in standard versions or to your specification.
Accurate parts also support efficient running, which matters to drivers watching fuel costs every day.
When fitting new engine parts, mechanics should always check the air filter and oil. A worn filter lets abrasive dust inside, and dirty oil shortens the life of new components quickly.
Engine parts can share a container with clutch and brake parts, labelled by model and part number so your team can shelve them quickly.
Our team can suggest a starting range based on the models common in your area and the repairs local workshops handle most often.
